authoritative_python_pattern.note: tests.yml includes --extra dev because it runs pytest; desktop-release runs only npm/Electron tests, so dev is excluded from the packaging sync

bundle_python_cjs.pyvenv_cfg_patch: nulls absolute home/base-executable so the copied venv is self-relative
bundle_python_cjs.smoke_test: imports site + pydantic in bundled interpreter (pydantic is a core dep, covered by plain sync)
stages: 2/4 validate source venv (THROWS if aetheros/.venv missing)

ci_failure_evidence.macos_error: Error: Cannot find a working virtual environment to bundle at /Users/runner/work/AetherOS/AetherOS/aetheros/.venv. Activate a venv or run `uv sync` first. (bundle-python.cjs:164 validateSourceVenv)
ci_failure_evidence.root_cause: workflow never creates aetheros/.venv: no setup-uv, no Python install, no uv sync before npm run build -> bundle-python.cjs; affects all platforms = provisioning defect, not platform defect
ci_failure_evidence.windows_error: Error: Cannot find a working virtual environment to bundle at D:\a\AetherOS\AetherOS\aetheros\.venv. Activate a venv or run `uv sync` first.

extras_decision.excluded_dev_reason: dev extra (pytest, debugpy, ruff, ty, mcp test stack) would bloat the shipped bundle; desktop-release runs only npm renderer + Electron tests, no Python pytest
extras_decision.excluded_matrix_reason: matrix extra pulls mautrix/python-olm with Linux-only wheels and no Windows/macOS build path (pyproject [all] policy comment, 2026-05-12); Dockerfile adds matrix only for its Linux image; cross-platform desktop builds must NOT include it

package_manager: uv (uv.lock present; tests.yml, Dockerfile, lint.yml all use astral-sh/setup-uv)
project_root: aetheros/ (pyproject.toml + uv.lock live here; NOT repo root)

python_contract.mix: selected 3.11 satisfies requires-python and bundler supported list
python_contract.workflow_command: uv sync --locked --python 3.11 --extra all (run with working-directory: aetheros)
